description: Creates a printable poster with a QR code for a card. Customers scan it, fill in a short form on a public Leal signup page, and add the card to their wallet. Returns the signup link and a print link. Colours default to the card's.

contact_collection_mode.description: What the signup form asks for. Default email_and_phone.

intent.description: Optional. One short sentence on what the person asked you to do, e.g. "Set up a stamp card for Ground Up Café". Leal shows it in the person's activity log under Settings → AI agents, so they can see what was done for them. Leave out customer details.

primary_color.description: Poster background colour, hex. Defaults to the card colour.

require_birthday.description: Ask for a birthday (for birthday rewards). Default false.

text_color.description: Poster text colour, hex. Defaults to the card's text colour.

title.description: Headline, e.g. "Join our coffee club". Defaults to the card name.

name: create_poster
title: Create a signup poster
